name: metricbraid
description: Evidence-aware routing for overlapping personal sensor data — decide which measurement an AI is allowed to believe, and record why.

plugins.name: metricbraid
plugins.description: Wires up the bundled Garmin + Oura MCP servers and installs a hardware-agnostic routing model: capability classes decide which source governs which channel, overlapping records are deduplicated rather than summed or averaged, every number carries provenance in a canonical form, and routing confidence is kept separate from measurement confidence so provisional and unresolved reasoning has to be stated out loud.
